notes: Voice chat rebuilt, Simple Voice Chat style. Press V for the new voice chat screen: smooth and clean, with players, groups and settings.
Groups: make one (Normal, Open or Isolated, with an optional password) and talk to your group from anywhere in the world.
Hold B to whisper (only people close by hear you). Talk with push to talk or voice activation, with a live level meter to set it.
Voices sound real: 3D direction, muffled through walls (more through wool, less through glass) and under water, and an echo in caves.
Noise suppression, echo cancellation, a microphone test, a volume for each player and a choice of microphone - in Settings.
